conversationalSummary.text: Today looks like there’s no really reliable window, and Baleal is probably not worth chasing with the wind angle looking poor and the swell feeling soft/sectiony on the sandbanks. I’d check Surfline and the MEO Beachcam before leaving—if it doesn’t look noticeably cleaner there, I’d save the drive. Even the best window (around evening) still feels like a stretch, so unless the cams surprise us, skip it.

best.explanation: Baleal looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 164 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 76/100, and wind is the main risk.  A broad, forgiving beach setup with several peaks; this is best for spreading out and finding a manageable wave when the bay has enough push; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is soft and sectiony on the Baleal sandbanks.
best.shortExplanation: Baleal is worth a quick check for evening — 19:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide is part of the picture, but not the deciding factor.
